title: Profile
description: An isolated context under one User: personal / business / joint / child. All money entities are scoped by profileId. App theme is derived from `type`. Spec §5, §11.3.

type.description: Drives navigation mode and theme context (§5.2, §13.1).

displayName.description: Human label shown in the profile switcher.

theme.description: Optional explicit theme override; otherwise resolved from `type`.
